props.children: line — two series, our tooltip at the axis pointer; a legend bound by id, placed by the fixture
anchors — click anywhere on the plot to pin that x (up to 3); every hovered value then shows its delta to each anchor; click an anchor to unpin, Esc or the chip clears
column and bar — a series with a status takes its colour; a mixed chart (bars with a line on a second axis)
bubble — a third value is the size
zoom — slider, the window at the last 5 %; a toolbar bound by id sets presets
linked — three charts share zoom and axis pointer (ECharts connect); the slider on the last one drives the three
renderer svg (same look, a DOM svg instead of a canvas) · the engine's own tooltip as an option
